card.name: Linking words before discontinuation terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "after", "follows" or "be" right before "discontinuation", "discontinuing" or "dosage reduction", usually where a label says a side effect resolved or improved.

modes.label: Resolution after stopping
modes.description: "after" or "follows" after resolved, improved or observed, just before discontinuation of treatment.
modes.example: Signs and symptoms generally improved<< after>> dosage reduction or discontinuation of the CNS

modes.label: Change after stopping a drug
modes.description: "after" before discontinuing, in statements about lab values changing once a drug is stopped.
modes.example: decreased within 1 to 2 weeks<< after>> discontinuing eltrombopag tablets

modes.label: Need not be discontinued
modes.description: "be" just before discontinued, in advice that treatment can continue.
modes.example: febuxostat tablets need not<< be>> discontinued.

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward stopping, increasing or extending words, mostly Chinese terms such as 停止 and 增加.
card.plain: It fires on the little word just before a label says the drug is stopped, as in "improved after..." discontinuation.
